name: ADS — Controlled GitHub Issue Creation v0.4 (disabled)

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO ads_issue_ledger(repository, notion_id, notion_edited_at, status)
  VALUES ($1, $2::uuid, $3::timestamptz, 'RESERVED')
  ON CONFLICT (repository, notion_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING repository, notion_id, status, issue_url
)
SELECT repository, notion_id, status, issue_url, true AS acquired FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT l.repository, l.notion_id, l.status, l.issue_url, false AS acquired
FROM ads_issue_ledger l
WHERE l.repository=$1 AND l.notion_id=$2::uuid
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted);
